Class AppAuthenticationProvider

java.lang.Object
com.sebastiandorata.musicdashboard.controller.Authentication.AppAuthenticationProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.security.authentication.AuthenticationProvider
@Component public class AppAuthenticationProvider extends Object implements org.springframework.security.authentication.AuthenticationProvider
Spring Security AuthenticationProvider that delegates to AuthenticationService.

The existing lockout and brute-force logic (LoginAttemptService, including the 5-second failed-attempt delay, which now simply runs on the request thread) stays the single source of truth. This provider only translates its outcomes into Spring Security exceptions carrying the same user-facing messages the desktop login card showed:

  • empty fields: BadCredentialsException "Please enter your username and password."
  • wrong credentials: BadCredentialsException with the remaining-attempts message
  • lockout (IllegalStateException): LockedException with the lockout message
  • any other failure: AuthenticationServiceException "Login failed: ..."

SRP: adapts the service to the Spring Security contract, nothing else.

DIP: depends on the service abstractions, not on repositories.
